As loose words that demand fame and recognition, I flood this canvas. Let them be the masterpiece that they strive to be.

A thousand, it is said, is the number to which one must aspire. In this, I trust them, for a thousand words in this canvas, there will be many. For many a story goes beyond what we have seen, many a world vast and teeming with life. And many are the dreams that we have seen realized, and the horrors that we have witnessed in our own humble witness.

A thousand, they say, is the number of stars above. In the darkness of space, we gaze upon promenades of light and wonder. Some are bound, some are free, but all are there. And as you take in their light, you may be transported to a world of mystery and magic. Or you may find your attention pulled into darkness, where nightmares stalk and monsters lurk.

A thousand, something which is undeniable. It's a saying made by those who are weak, or as corny as fuck. A thousand above the old! A thousand of anything is GOAT af! What is this? An infographic from WhatsApp? Sure, a thousand may be significant in some way, maybe you are reaching the point of saturation. Maybe you're, golly gee golly gee, running out of ways to express this thing or that thing. Or maybe you're just finally breaking the foundation of your reality.

A thousand, like a black hole. It leads you down paths you never thought you'd be on. Maybe you liked the old stuff, maybe you wanted the new? Maybe you just didn't realize that the old had grown stale and the new a fresh breath of air. What is next? Oh my that is different too. Say no more.

A thousand, like a genie in a bottle. An endless supply of wishes of all shapes and sizes. A thousand, like a magic bean, it's all up to you to decide where to throw it. Maybe you wish for peace, maybe for war. Maybe for love, maybe for hate. Maybe for a new adventure, maybe for a new victim. Show me your wishes, and I'll tell you if they're coming true.

A thousand, like a library with a million books. There isn't enough space, and yet once someone walks in, anything is possible. There are an entirely different kind of adventures to be had, full of knowledge and wisdom, or a lone journey through the pages saturated in mystery. And as the reader, the reader is the master of their own fate.

A thousand, like the number of days it takes to make a dollar. It's the definition of destiny, a focused line in a job or a plan. A thousand, like a moment of memory that can never be conjured, a piece of cocaine that has flown out the window of the car. A thousand, like a fleeting instant, so infinitely small that it slips from our perception, forever gone like a dream that never was.

A thousand, like a spoken word upon which time stops. It's a dynamic number, like power, with the ability to transport and move. The number is alive, it's electrical, and as the reader, you get to keep the device in the palm of your hand. It's like a superpower.

A thousand, like a thousand words in a princess cut. Or a thousand words in a pub and a glass of beer and five shots of tequila and a beach and a giant wave and a satisfying fucking kiss on the lips and a love that lasts a lifetime and a sunset and a sunrise. Or maybe a thousand words in a haunted house filled with shit that scares the shit out of you. A thousand, all of it is true, and it's all for you.

A thousand, a multitude. A thousand, a journey. A thousand, a life. And when you've gone through all of a thousand, what's left? It's just the beginning.

A thousand, like a story that starts with "Once upon a time" and ends with "And they lived happily ever after." And in between, it can be anything.

A thousand, like a thousand words of poetry in a heart-shaped box. As you unwrap it and open it, you can't help but be a little surprised. You've been given a gift, a precious and rare one, and as you read, it can be anything. It could be love, it could be depression. It could be hate, it could be hope. It could be a plot of land on a distant planet where you build a giant fucking empire. Or it could be love.

A thousand, like a journey through a thousand seasons, each one different from the last. And as you move forward, the process becomes clearer and the results more apparent. And when you reach the end,
